pages.title: Critical Feeding
pages.text: $(2)Fat Man$(0) requires exactly $(4)3 cans$(0) of Plutonium Cat Food to reach critical mass.$(br2)$(c)DANGER ZONE:$(0)$(br)Lure him far away from your base or beloved structures before administering the final meal! The blast will completely excavate an enormous crater.

pages.title: Detonation Sequence
pages.text: Upon consuming the third can, an emergency klaxon sounds and a $(c)10-second fuse$(0) begins.$(br2)Drink a $(9)Potion of Swiftness$(0) and sprint $(4)60+ blocks$(0) away immediately. Surviving in the immediate blast zone without divine protection is virtually impossible.
